scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('public/.well-known')){fs.mkdirSync('dist/.well-known',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('public/.well-known','dist/.well-known',{recursive:true});console.log('[build] .well-known copied to dist')}else{console.error('[build] WARNING: public/.well-known not found')}"
